steps.raw_repr:
b'lineproj
Choose a starting template
  1. rest       Minimal REST API on ag-core (Shield + axum) with one example route.
  2. realtime   WebSocket server on ag-core with a /ws echo route.
  3. fullstack  REST API with PostgreSQL persistence through ag-data and SQL migrations.
  4. layered    Opt-in layered workspace (domain/app/infra/api) with an ag.toml manifest.
  5. static-site Static HTML/CSS/JS site served by a minimal axum handler.
  6. marketing-site Marketing landing page with hero, features and contact sections.
  7. blog       Server-rendered blog with a post index and article view.
  8. docs-site  Documentation site with navigation and search-ready structure.
  9. dashboard  Analytics dashboard shell with layout and chart placeholders.
  10. admin-panel Admin panel with an auth guard placeholder and CRUD table layout.
  11. database-api REST API with a database-backed repository and migrations.
  12. auth-service Authentication service with registration, login and JWT sessions.
  13. multi-tenant-saas Multi-tenant SaaS API with tenant isolation scaffolding.
  14. webhook-gateway Inbound webhook receiver with signature verification and retry queue.
  15. file-upload-service Multipart file upload API with a local storage adapter.
  16. ecommerce-lite Lightweight e-commerce API: catalog, cart and checkout stubs.
  17. realtime-chat-v2 Chat server with rooms and WebSocket/SSE transport.
  18. websocket-service WebSocket service with typed messages and broadcast.
  19. worker-service Background worker host with typed jobs and an in-memory queue.
  20. scheduled-jobs Cron-like scheduled job runner built on ag-workers.
  21. iot-ingest Telemetry ingestion endpoint with batch buffering.
  22. edge-router Edge routing policy scaffold using ag-edge hostname rules.
  23. mail-service Transactional mail service with native SMTP/MTA senders.
  24. dns-manager DNS record manager with a provider adapter and SPF/DKIM/DMARC output.
  25. object-storage-api Object storage API with local and pluggable bucket adapters.
  26. monitoring-service Metrics and health endpoint scaffold with OpenTelemetry wiring.
  27. microservices-starter Starter for a multi-service workspace with shared contracts.
  28. cli-tool   Standalone CLI binary scaffold using clap and ag-core.
  29. ai-backend-template AI backend with /health and a provider-agnostic /chat stub.
  30. vector-search Vector search API with embeddings and a similarity query stub.
  31. rag-pipeline Retrieval-augmented generation pipeline scaffold.
  32. wasi-plugin WASI plugin scaffold for ag-wasm-host extensions.
  33. testing-suite Integration, fuzz and benchmark test harness scaffold.
Template number [1]: '
